summary: The roster refresher's card-faults read is bounded by its 25 ms CPU work clock, with a one-second wall backstop, so a scheduling pause on a loaded host no longer turns published agent faults into retained or "fault status unknown" values.

replay.detail: No graph replay or backfill; the same faults are read at the same snapshot cut.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger, schema version, claim kind or claim field changes.

rules.detail: No authority, write-rule, checkpoint or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: A card-faults capture with no enclosing request that reads an already pinned snapshot (the roster refresher) keeps its 25 ms CPU work allowance and now has a one-second wall bound instead of 25 ms; nothing waits for reader admission there. Request reads and unpinned non-request captures are unchanged. The documented degradation (previous fault, or "fault status unknown", retried on the next refresh) still applies when the work clock or the backstop expires. Response shapes are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Ordinary binary restart; no ordering between members.

recovery.detail: In-memory read policy only. Returning to the previous binary restores the 25 ms wall bound with no data migration.
